statements.status_notes: Neo4j states there is no security impact on Neo4j products for this log escaping issue; XSS requires opening query logs in an external HTML-rendering tool. See https://neo4j.com/security/cve-2026-1337/. The calver 2026.01 line includes the escaping fix; the v5 line has no backport.
